clips.title: The story
paras: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass sends you into Blackfathom Deeps to find the scout who went missing there. The Argent Dawn fears naga and Twilight's Hammer cultists have joined forces in the flooded ruins.

The Argent Dawn watches for threats across Kalimdor as well as the Scourge in Lordaeron. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass gathers reports from Darnassus about unnatural dangers. Word reaches him that naga and the doomsday zealots of the Twilight's Hammer have made a pact in Blackfathom Deeps, the flooded ruins along the Ashenvale shore. The order fears what this alliance could bring.

Argent Guard Thaelrid entered the caverns to investigate the coastal rumors. Weeks have passed without word, and Shaedlass's other scouts are away on separate operations. He fears Thaelrid has fallen or been captured by the dark powers beneath the waves. Now he asks you to enter Blackfathom Deeps and bring the missing scout back alive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many rumors circulate these days about the union of the Twilight's Hammer and the naga in Blackfathom Deeps on the coasts of Ashenvale.
My role here with the Argent Dawn is to collect as much information as I can, so we know when and where help is needed.
It has been weeks now since I sent a scout to check on the activity at Blackfathom Deeps. Argent Guard Thaelrid has not yet reported back.
My other scouts are preoccupied with pressing matters.
Seek out and aid Thaelrid for me, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.
